_README.name: Concession props — droppable economy pack
_README.description: Map-agnostic prop pack for a resource-constrained run: priced foods + vendors that sell them for Cyphers. Drop into ANY run by layering this sidecar and scattering the vendor refs onto navigable cells at startup (ItemService.spawnItem) — no .map.gram edit required. Foods are consumables (tokens => Fuel on consume); attrs.price/strain/tol/rest carry the economic + physiological profile. Vendors are carriable:false fixtures; attrs.stock lists 'foodRef:cypherPrice' pairs (per-vendor price overrides the food's base price), attrs.concurrent=1 enforces one transaction at a time. See RFC-0028. The leading underscore marks this as documentation, not a spawnable item.
